alerts.description:
Service Changes:
Downtown [E] trains are rerouted via Roosevelt Island from Jackson Heights-Roosevelt Av to 47-50 Sts-Rockefeller Ctr, then via the [F] to W 4 St-Wash Sq.

Downtown [F] trains are rerouted via Roosevelt Island from Jackson Heights-Roosevelt Av to 47-50 Sts-Rockefeller Ctr.

Some downtown [F] trains are rerouted via the [G] from Court Sq to Bergen St, bypassing Manhattan.

Listen for crew announcements to hear how your train will run.

What's Happening?
We're investigating why a train's brakes near Court Sq-23 St.

Expect Church Av-bound [G] delays while they share tracks with rerouted trains.

definitions.position: First remaining stop in a feed report: approaching, stopped at, or about to leave. Not GPS or independently measured train location.
definitions.arrival: Future official stop-time predictions, not observed arrivals. Estimates expire with source freshness or when the predicted time passes.
definitions.scope: Assigned unambiguous E service reports in the ACE feed, not all physical trains. Other lines are not supported.

previousVersion.validation: Frozen v1 estimates; known guard/replay limitations. Not combined with v2.

history.EHistory: Deterministic replay of retained original E attempts plus new observations; same fixed thresholds.
history.FHistory: New v2 observations only. Pre-v2 failure/reset timings are incomplete and were not reconstructed.

operational.definition: Model-estimated operational conditions from retained future predictions and guarded reported stop transitions. Delay=max(0,min(prediction drift,elapsed beyond expected arrival)). Headway compares future station forecasts with maximum date-valid scheduled spacing for the same remaining stopping pattern. Slow segment requires at least five minutes excess elapsed over its date-valid scheduled segment and an eligible delay flag.
operational.limitations: Not verified physical lateness or a SubwayNow replica. Missing optional entity clocks do not veto estimates; present future/stale/regressed clocks, source gaps, aliases/path changes and terminals are guarded. Waits/headways are forecasts, not measured rider waits. Assigned E/F reports only; unassigned/upcoming or unseen trains may shorten predicted gaps. No all-train denominator, cancellations or ranking. Schedule validity ends at its stated date; unavailable baselines stay unknown.
